name: Check Destiny connectivity
command: set -u; echo dns:; getent ahosts destiny.whatbox.ca | head -10; echo http4:; curl -4 -sS -o /tmp/destiny-web -w '%{http_code}\n' --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 15 http://destiny.whatbox.ca:12345/api/health || true; echo https:; curl -4 -k -sS -o /tmp/destiny-https -w '%{http_code}\n' --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 15 https://destiny.whatbox.ca:12345/api/health || true
description: Check Destiny’s public DNS and WebUI reachability over IPv4 and HTTPS.
